name: claw-heartbeat
description: Claw mod: wakes Claw up on a schedule inside a running Claude Code session. Daily briefing at a set time, periodic checks for overdue tasks, quiet hours, and an optional auto-run mode that makes Claude do the heartbeat by itself.

claw_dir.title: Claw folder
claw_dir.description: Folder with SOUL.md, MEMORY.md and TASKS.md. Use the same folder for every Claw mod.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: notify: show a reminder only. auto-run: let Claude run the briefing and heartbeat by itself when the session is idle.

briefing_time.title: Daily briefing time
briefing_time.description: HH:MM, local time. Leave empty to turn the daily briefing off.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: HH:MM-HH:MM during which Claw stays silent. Leave empty for none.
